description: This file is a Makefile used for building and packaging software in the OpenWrt build system. It contains build rules, variable definitions, include directives, and functions for managing package compilation, installation, and distribution.

methods.name: pkg_build_flag
methods.description: Defines a function to check if a specific build flag is set in PKG_BUILD_FLAGS, returning 1 if set, 0 if no, or a default value.

methods.name: Build/Exports/Default
methods.description: Defines environment variable exports for build steps, including include paths, staging prefix, and other environment variables.

methods.name: Build/CoreTargets
methods.description: Defines core build targets and steps such as download, prepare, configure, compile, install, and cleanup, with dependencies and hooks.

methods.name: Build/DefaultTargets
methods.description: Sets up default build targets, including download, core targets, and conditional cleaning based on flags.

methods.name: BuildPackage
methods.description: Main function to define a package build process, including validation, dependency resolution, and invoking build steps.
